senses.gloss: उप-जिगमिषु mfn. (fr. Desid.), wishing or desiring to go near, Megh. 43.
उप-जिगमिषु See उप-√ गम्.
उप-जिघ्रण f(आ)n. the act of smelling at, Car.
उप-जिघ्रण See उप-√ घ्रा.

1. उप-ज॑ (for 2. See p. 198, col. 1) mfn. (√ जन्), additional, accessory, ŚBr. i, 1, 1, 10 (Sāy. reads उप-च॑म् [√ 1. चि]; see Weber's extracts from the Comm. on the above passage, where, T. reads correctly त्रिचतुर-मासाद् आरोपितम् instead of तृचतुरान् माखाबपितम् [?]).
2. उप-ज mfn. (for 1. See s.v.) produced or coming from, Gaut. xii, 36, &c.
उप-ज m. N. of a deity.
उप-जा f. distant or not immediate posterity, AV. xi, 1, 19.
उप-जगती f. a particular metre (a variety of the Triṣṭubh; three Pādas containing twelve instants instead of eleven), RPrāt.
उप-जन m. addition, increase
appendage, ĀśvŚr.; ChUp. Comm. on Nyāyam. &c.
addition of a letter (in the formation of a word), letters or syllables or affixes added, RPrāt.; APrāt.; Nir.; Sāy. &c.
उप-जनन n. generation, procreation, MānGṛ. i, 14.
उप-जात mfn. added, additional, APrāt. &c.
produced, engendered, aroused, originated, MBh.; Daś. &c.
उप-जात—कोप or उप-जात—क्रोध, mfn. one whose anger is aroused, provoked, excited, Prab.
उप-जात—कोप or उप-जात—क्रोध, mfn. one whose anger is aroused, provoked, excited, Prab.
उप-जात—खेद mfn. suffering from exhaustion, faint, feeble, Mṛcch.
उप-जात—विश्वास mfn. inspired with confidence, confident, trusting, believing, Hit.
उप-जाति f. a mixed metre (esp. a combination of Indra-vajrā and Upendra-vajrā, or of Vaṃśa-stha and Indra-vaṃśa).
उपजातिका f. id.
उप-जनम् ind. near the people, Kir. iv, 1.
before men, in presence of others, Kir.
उप-जन्धनि m. N. of a man, SkandaP.
उप-जप्त mfn. brought over or instigated to rebellion (by whispering into the ear &c.)
उप-जप्य mfn. to be brought over or instigated to rebellion (cf. the last), Mn. vii, 197; Bhaṭṭ.
उप-जाप m. the act of rousing to rebellion or bringing over to one's own party (see above), Hit.; Pañcat.; Daś.; Śiś. &c.
उप-जापक mfn. one who brings over to his party or one who rouses to rebellion (by whispering into the ear &c.), Mn. ix, 275.
उप-जरसम् ind. towards or near old age, cf. Pāṇ. v, 4, 107.
उप-जला f. N. of a river, MBh.
उप-√ जल्प्
उप-जल्पित n. talk, R. ii, 60, 14.
उपजल्पिन् mfn. talking to a person, giving advice, MBh. i, 5396.
उप-जानु ind. in or near the knee, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 40.
उप-√ जि P. -जयति, to acquire by conquest, gain, obtain, GopBr. ii, 2, 16.
उप-जिज्ञासु See उप-√ ज्ञा.
उप-जिज्ञासु mfn. (fr. Desid.), wishing to know or to become acquainted with, MBh. xii, 3884.
उप-जिहीर्षा f. See उप-√ हृ.
उप-जिहीर्षा f. the wish or intention to take away or to rob, MBh.
उप-जिह्वा f. the epiglottis, Yājñ. iii, 97
an abscess on the under side of the tongue, Suśr.
a kind of ant, L.
उप-जि॑ह्विका f. a kind of ant, RV. viii, 102, 21
the epiglottis, Car.
an abscess (see above), Suśr.
उप-जीका f. a kind of ant, AV. ii, 3, 4; vi, 100, 2.
उप-जीव॑ mfn. probably not very different in meaning from जीव॑, q.v., AV. xix, 69, 2
उप-जीवा॑ (आ॑), f. subsistence, TBr. i, 5, 6, 4.
उप-जीवितृ mfn. living on (gen.), Mn., Sch.
उप-जीवक mfn. living upon, subsisting by (with instr. or ifc.), MBh.; R.; Kathās. Comm. on Mn.
living under, depending upon, subject to, a dependant, servant, Kathās.
उप-जीवक f(इका)n. subsistence, livelihood, L.
उप-जी॑वन n. livelihood, subsistence, ŚBr.; Mn. ix, 207; Yājñ. iii, 236; MBh.; Pañcat. &c.
dependance, submissiveness, Prasannar.
उपजीवनी॑य mfn. affording or serving for livelihood, AV. viii, 10, 22-29; TS.; ŚBr.
उप-जीविन् mfn. living on, subsisting by (with acc. or gen. or ifc.), MBh.; Mn.; Yājñ. &c.
living in dependence, dependent, subject, MBh.; Ragh.; Rājat. &c.
submissive, humble, Ratnāv.
1. उप-जीव्य mfn. that by which one lives, affording or serving for a livelihood, MBh.; Yājñ. &c.
that on which one depends or rests, Daś.; Sāh.
2. उप-जीव्य ind.p. having lived upon
depending on, because of (with acc.)
उप-√ जुष् P. (pf. 3. pl. -जुजुषुस्) to excite pleasure, gladden, RV. viii, 23, 9.
उप-जोष m. desire, pleasure, liking See यथोपजोषम्
उप-जोषम् ind. according to one's desire or liking, L.
silently, quietly, Śak. 202, 8 v.l.
उप-जोषण n. enjoyment, use
taking (food), BhP. v, 16, 19.
1. उप-√ ज्ञा Ā. -जानीते (3. pl. -जानते, AV.) to ascertain, excogitate, invent, find out, hit upon, AV. iv, 36, 8; ŚBr.
2. उप-ज्ञा f. knowledge found out or invented by one's self (not handed down by tradition), untaught or primitive knowledge, invention, Pāṇ.; L.
उप-ज्ञा (mfn. ifc.) invented or first taught by, unknown before, Ragh. xv, 63, Kāś. & Siddh. on Pāṇ. ii, 4, 21 and vi, 2, 14; Bhaṭṭ.
उप-जिज्ञास्य᳙ mfn. to be excogitated or found out
enigmatical, ŚBr. iii, 2, 1, 24.
(also) to be informed of all, MBh.
उ॑प-ज्ञात mfn. excogitated, invented, found out
ascertained by one's self, unknown before, ŚBr.; Pāṇ.
उ॑प-ज्मन् m. (√ गम्), way, path [NBD.], SV. i, 4, 1, 5, 6.
उप-ज्योतिष n. a compendium of astronomy, VarBṛS.
उप-√ ज्रि P. -ज्रयति, to go near to, RV. ix, 71, 5.
उप-√ ज्वल्
उप-ज्वलन mfn. fit for kindling fire, ĀpŚr.
उप-ज्वलित mfn. lighted up (with अन्˚ neg.), ŚBr. xi, 8, 3, 7.
उपाज् (उप-√ अज्) P. (Impv. उपा॑जतु, RV. x, 19, 2) Ā. (1. sg. उ॑पाजे, AV. v, 11, 2; impf. उ॑पाजत, RV. i, 161, 6) to drive near or towards.
उपाजे ind. so as to help or support (optionally to be regarded as a गति [q.v.] in connection with √ कृ, Pāṇ. i, 4, 73; उपाजे-कृत्य or उपाजे कृत्वा ind.p. having helped, supporting, Kāś. on Pāṇ.)
उपाजिनम् ind. on a skin, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 194.
